description: Motion quality canon for animated or sequential visual outputs.

quality_dimensions.name: Temporal Coherence
quality_dimensions.description: Visual elements must remain consistent across frames.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Character appearance, clothing, and environment stable across frames.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Sudden changes in clothing, features, or environment without narrative cause.

quality_dimensions.name: Motion Smoothness
quality_dimensions.description: Movement must appear smooth and physically plausible.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: No jitter, stutter, or unnatural speed changes in motion.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Jittery, robotic, or physically impossible motion trajectories.

quality_dimensions.name: Camera Motion Plausibility
quality_dimensions.description: Camera movements must feel intentional and cinematic.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Camera moves follow cinematic conventions. No accidental shake.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Unintentional camera shake, jarring cuts, or disorienting motion.
